hist_case.problem: Founder requested a live, autonomous Taloa-ChatGPT-Claude relay (3+ round trips, no manual copy/paste). GATE0-001 (the one real dependency the relay blueprint declared) landed on main 2026-08-16 (commit f7223d878cd8ba09a334ee2cca92ef00848537f9), verified by reading the committed bytes directly, not the dispatch response alone.
hist_case.case_text: The relay blueprint (TALOA_CHATGPT_RELAY_AND_CAPSULE_BLUEPRINT_2026-08-15.md) covers a long list of capabilities (perception, composer control, file transfer, Capsule learning). This mission deliberately scopes to only the piece that is honestly buildable and SENTRY-verifiable through the Railway-hosted governed factory: server-side task authorization (via GATE0-001's verify()) and relay-turn state tracking. The native macOS Accessibility/mouse/keyboard control code that actually operates a real Chrome/ChatGPT window is explicitly out of scope for this mission, because SENTRY here runs on Linux and cannot compile Swift or exercise Accessibility APIs -- a structural pass there would not be proof the live relay works, and claiming otherwise would violate this repo's own honesty standard.
ideas: Split the relay into a server-verifiable orchestration layer (this mission) and a Mac-verifiable UI-control layer (native/macos-overlay/, requires running on a real Mac to prove anything).

Authorization for every relay action routes through the same envelope.verify() primitive GATE0-001 built, never from observed conversation content -- closes the same prompt-injection gap the source blueprint's §46 names as undefended.
hist_case.opportunity: This mission produces the real, verifiable half of the relay now. The remaining half (actual browser/window control) is a distinct, honestly-scoped follow-up that needs Mac-side execution to mean anything.

cfo_receipt.note: Founder-directed continuation immediately following GATE0-001 landing; authoring cost accrues per step (2 steps: RELAY-001, RELAY-002) under the standard tier ladder.
